heading.title: Appeals, Revisions and Alternate Dispute Resolutions

article.title: Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings.
article.content: No proceeding before, or pronouncement of advance ruling by, the Board for Advance Rulings, shall be questioned or shall be invalid on the ground merely of the existence of any vacancy or defect in the constitution of the Board for Advance Rulings.
article.html:
382Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings.

Section 382 · Chapter XVIII · D.—Alternate Dispute Resolutions — 2.—Advance rulings · page 449 of the Act

No proceeding before, or pronouncement of advance ruling by, the Board for Advance Rulings, shall be questioned or shall be invalid on the ground merely of the existence of any vacancy or defect in the constitution of the Board for Advance Rulings.
